name: io.github.dembrandt/dembrandt
title: Dembrandt
description: Design tokens from any live site: colors, type, spacing, DTCG, Tailwind, drift checks.

environmentVariables.name: DEMBRANDT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from dembrandt.com/app/api-keys. Uploads each extraction as a snapshot and scores it against the previous one for that domain.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_CDP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Connect to an already running Chromium over CDP instead of launching one, e.g. http://localhost:9222.
